note: One entry per device target. `dpr` is the device pixel ratio used for BOTH the web capture and the Compose render, so screenshots are directly comparable pixel for pixel. `windowSizeClass` maps to androidx.compose.material3.windowsizeclass: width < 600dp = compact, 600..839 = medium, >= 840 = expanded.

statusBar.note: system bars are masked out of the diff, not emulated

phone.label: Phone
phone.notes: Primary target of the bundled prototype: bottom nav, mini player, full-screen player.

tablet.label: Tablet
tablet.notes: Uses the two-pane layout: rail/sidebar + content, no bottom nav.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.notes: Compose Desktop target when the project has one (SimpMusic does); otherwise the same layout in an expanded-window Android build, with the limits documented.
